us.note: Terrorism & crime. Higher risk on the Somalia border and parts of the north coast (Lamu). Eastleigh & Kibera are Reconsider Travel (Level 3), NOT Do Not Travel. Rendered page still dated 17 March 2025 when checked 2 Aug 2026 — the late-July re-issue did not change the page text.

uk.note: Against travel to the Kenya–Somalia border and parts of Lamu/north coast; core safari & coast areas unaffected.

us.note: Do not travel — Ebola (Bundibugyo) outbreak in the region.

uk.note: Against all-but-essential travel to parts of western Uganda (Queen Elizabeth & Semuliki NP). Elections aftermath — avoid crowds.

us.note: Reconsider travel — RAISED from Level 2 to 3 on 31 Oct 2025 ('unrest' indicator added). Grounds: unrest, crime, terrorism (highest risk in the Mtwara Region near the Mozambique border), and targeting of gay & lesbian individuals. Verified vs travel.state.gov 4 Aug 2026.

uk.note: No advisory against travel except within 20km of the Mozambique (Cabo Delgado) border.

us.note: As mainland Tanzania (Level 3 since 31 Oct 2025); no Zanzibar-specific carve-out. Verified 4 Aug 2026.
Reconsider travel — regional Ebola risk and DRC border security.

uk.note: Against all-but-essential travel to areas near the DRC and Burundi borders (Rubavu, Rusizi).
